items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I made the records with Hug, yeah.

ctx.x: couldn't release them because Rosemary Clooney sang and Rosemary Clooney was an exclusive Columbia recording artist and they wouldn't let the records loose. Joe Moretz made the records and they wouldn't turn the records loose. He played with Almond Hug, you made the records with Hug. I made the records with Hug, yeah.
Almond said how wonderful it was he could just walk in the studio and hear those tunes and come up.

items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: And Joe Lloyd Cannon was playing bass.

ctx.x: What would they play? Did you play both?

Well, let's see. I think Gene Meyer was playing, or Meyer Weinboy was playing alto lead. Fazz was playing third sax, I believe, in those days. And Scagliona was playing tenor, if I'm not mistaken. That was a real good band. And Joe Lloyd Cannon was playing bass. Aubrey Schlang played drums. That was a real good spot.
How did that deal work there? Who would have the band in charge? Shawkey.
